name: mospi_in_options
description: What India's Ministry of Statistics (MoSPI) publishes for the Index of Industrial Production (iip) and the Wholesale Price Index (wpi): the base years available (newest first), and for one base year the years, the series you can ask for (IIP: General, sectoral and use-based categories; WPI: major groups and groups) and the LATEST month that has data. Start here to learn the latest period and the exact series names for mospi_in_get_data. India only.

product.description: "iip" = Index of Industrial Production, "wpi" = Wholesale Price Index.

base_year.description: Base year such as "2022-23" or "2011-12". Default: the newest base.

name: mospi_in_search_series
description: Find an Indian wholesale-price series (a commodity, item, group or sub-group such as "wheat", "mineral oils", "pulses") or an industrial-production category ("capital goods", "manufacturing", "electricity") by words in its name. Returns the series label and level; pass the label to mospi_in_get_data as `series`. Newest base year unless base_year is given. India only.

query.description: Words from the series name, e.g. "wheat", "mineral oils", "capital goods".

product.description: Restrict to one product. Default searches both.

base_year.description: Base year; default newest for each product.

name: mospi_in_get_data
description: Get India's Index of Industrial Production (iip) or Wholesale Price Index (wpi) for a month, a year, or the latest month. Returns index values (and IIP year-on-year growth rate) with base year, period and series labels. `series` names what to read: IIP "General" (default), "Sectoral", "Use-based category" or a category such as "Manufacturing" (which returns its sub-categories); WPI an all-commodities index (default), a group, sub-group or item such as "Wheat". Omit year and month for the latest month that has data. Uses the newest base year unless base_year is given; index levels from different base years are not comparable. India only.

series.description: Series name or code from mospi_in_options / mospi_in_search_series. Default: the overall index (IIP General, WPI all commodities).

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2026. Omit (with month) for the latest month.

month.description: Month number 1-12, a month name, or "all". With a year and no month, all months of that year are returned.
